## AimOffset  (type-only)
interface AimOffset {
    readonly joints: Int16Array;
    readonly weights: Float32Array;
    readonly maxYaw: number;
    readonly maxPitch: number;
    readonly forward: Float32Array;
    readonly up: Float32Array;
    yaw: number;
    pitch: number;
    readonly saved: Float32Array;
}

    up?: ArrayLike<number>;
}

## AnimBlendMode  (type-only)
type AnimBlendMode = 'override' | 'additive';

## AnimGraph  (type-only)
interface AnimGraph {
    readonly params: AnimGraphParams;
    readonly state: string;
    readonly previous: string;
    set(param: string, value: number | boolean): void;
    get(param: string): number | boolean;
    update(dt: number): void;
    onEnter(state: string, fn: AnimGraphListener): () => void;
    onExit(state: string, fn: AnimGraphListener): () => void;
    weight(state: string): number;
    actions(state: string): readonly AnimationAction[];
    phase(state: string): number;
    go(state: string, fade?: number, opts?: {
        matchPose?: boolean;
    }): void;
}

interface AnimGraphBlend1D {

interface AnimGraphBlend2D {

interface AnimGraphDesc {

## AnimGraphListener  (type-only)

## AnimGraphParams  (type-only)
type AnimGraphParams = Record<string, number | boolean>;

## AnimGraphStateDesc  (type-only)
type AnimGraphStateDesc = AnimGraphClipState | AnimGraphBlendState;

## AnimGraphTransition  (type-only)
interface AnimGraphTransition {
    from: string | '*';
    to: string;
    when: (params: AnimGraphParams) => boolean;
    fade: number;
    exitTime?: number;
    matchPose?: boolean;
}

## AnimationAction
class AnimationAction {
    clip: AnimationClip | null;
    layer: number;
    weight: number;
    loop: boolean;
    speed: number;
    time: number;
    paused: boolean;
    blend: AnimBlendMode;
    finished: boolean;
    effectiveWeight: number;
    fadeFrom: number;
    fadeTo: number;
    fadeDuration: number;
    fadeElapsed: number;
    fresh: boolean;
    cursor: ClipCursor;
    get active(): boolean;
    get fade(): number;
    startFade(to: number, seconds: number): void;
}

## AnimationEventListener  (type-only)

## AnimationMixer
class AnimationMixer {
    readonly skeleton: Skeleton;
    readonly pose: Pose;
    readonly actions: readonly AnimationAction[];
    constructor(skeleton: Skeleton, opts?: AnimationMixerOptions);
    get playing(): number;
    play(clip: AnimationClip, opts?: AnimPlayOptions): AnimationAction;
    crossFade(from: AnimationAction, to: AnimationClip | AnimationAction, seconds: number, opts?: AnimPlayOptions): AnimationAction;
    stop(action: AnimationAction, seconds?: number): void;
    stopAll(): void;
    onEvent(cb: AnimationEventListener): () => void;
    update(dt: number): void;
}

## AnimationMixerOptions  (type-only)
interface AnimationMixerOptions {
    maxActions?: number;
}

## FootIk  (type-only)
interface FootIk {
    readonly feet: readonly FootIkFootDesc[];

    readonly pelvis: number;

    readonly grounded: Uint8Array;

    readonly normals: Float32Array;
    readonly tips: Float32Array;
    readonly world: Float32Array;
}
